name: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd.
business_summary: Second-tier Indian cigarette maker (Four Square, Red & White, Cavanders; Marlboro distributed under a Philip Morris International arrangement), with smaller chewing/pan-masala, leaf-tobacco export and convenience-retail (24Seven/Lasa) lines. Promoters (K.K. Modi group) hold 72.6%. Almost debt-free with large treasury investments (a Trade Brains piece cites ~Rs 6,000 cr of reserves, 2026-09-23). Highly exposed to the tax regime: Q1 FY27 net profit fell ~44% y/y.

exposures.mechanism: Cigarettes ~90% of EBIT, less diversified and less pricing power than ITC. +10% tax burden: ~60% price pass-through, volume -4-5%, margin squeeze => cigarette EBIT about -8%, group -7.5%; structural persistence 1.0; EV/MCap ~0.85 (net cash) => -6.5 to -7.5. Evidence: Q1 FY27 sales 1,206 cr (vs 1,486 cr), OPM 15% (vs 23%), PAT 198 cr (-44% y/y).

evidence.note: NDTV Profit: Godfrey Phillips Q1 profit falls 44%, margins contract sharply
screener quarterly table: Jun-26 OP 181 vs 338

exposures.mechanism: Enforcement against illicit/duty-evaded sticks returns volume to legal brands. Small-cap smoker mix is more price-sensitive and vulnerable to illicit substitution, so enforcement upside is larger than for ITC: +1 => legal volume +3% => EBIT +4% x persistence 0.4.

evidence.note: New Indian Express: cigarette industry stares at turbulent FY27 as tax hike, illicit trade cloud outlook

exposures.mechanism: Premium cigarettes (Marlboro, Four Square) skew to urban consumers: +5pp urban growth => volumes +1.5%, EBIT +3% at high operating leverage, x0.5 persistence => ~+1.2.
Red & White / lower-priced brands sell in smaller towns and rural India; +5pp rural => volumes +1%; EBIT +2% x0.5 persistence => +0.7.

evidence.note: Moneycontrol: weak monsoon pressures rural demand

exposures.mechanism: Imported tobacco/filter components and Marlboro-linked costs (~10% of costs) vs export leaf revenue. Net slightly negative; empirical -2.86 (t=-1.1) is statistically weak and the stock's 1.3 beta makes it a risk-off proxy rather than an FX stock.
Cartons, foils, filters ~7% of costs. +10% => costs +0.7% => EBITDA -0.9% at 23% margin; 40% passthrough; persistence 0.5 => -0.3 to -0.4.
Logistics, polymer filters, retail energy; indirect. Empirical -1.19 (t=-1.3) includes beta; fundamental effect small ~ -0.4.
Debt-free; treasury income ~Rs 100 cr+ per year benefits from higher yields but valuation multiple (P/E 20.5) falls: net -0.5.

evidence.note: P/E 20.5, interest cost 3 cr per quarter

exposures.mechanism: 1y volatility 47% annualised, market beta 1.3-1.5, thin float (promoters 72.6%). +5 VIX points => high-beta midcap -1.3 (beta 1.3 x typical -1% Nifty).
FIIs hold 7.9%; midcap. +US$5bn/quarter inflows lift high-beta midcaps ~+1.2.
